auth_type.description: Authentication selector used by rendered auth and rate-limit policies. Use 'token' or 'oauth' for a personal or OAuth token, 'github_app' for an installation token, 'github_token' for the GitHub Actions token, or 'public', 'none', 'anonymous', or 'unauthenticated' for explicitly unauthenticated traffic. App configuration identified by app_id is normalized to the GitHub App installation policy.

base_url.description: GitHub API base URL override for tests or GitHub Enterprise.

installation_id.description: GitHub App installation ID for auth_type=github_app.

installation_permissions.description: Optional JSON object of requested GitHub App installation-token permissions.

installation_repositories.description: Optional comma-separated repository names for a restricted installation token.

installation_repository_ids.description: Optional comma-separated repository IDs for a restricted installation token.

owner.description: Repository owner (user or organization login). Owner and repository are separate keys so each path-template value is encoded as one bounded path segment.

private_key.description: GitHub App PEM private key for auth_type=github_app. Never logged.

private_key_base64.description: Base64-encoded GitHub App PEM private key for auth_type=github_app (alternative to private_key). Never logged.

public_access.description: Explicit opt-in for unauthenticated public reads. Set to a non-empty value to allow reads without token or app credentials. When this and an unauthenticated auth_type are absent, the runtime requires a token or complete GitHub App credentials and fails closed.

rate_limit_account.description: Authenticated GitHub user login used only as the non-secret coordination subject for auth_type=token or oauth rate limits. It is not a token and need not match the target repository owner.

rate_limit_ip.description: Originating public IP address used only as the non-secret coordination subject for unauthenticated GitHub rate limits.

rate_limit_repository.description: Repository identity in owner/repo form used only as the non-secret coordination subject for auth_type=github_token GitHub Actions rate limits.

repo.description: Repository name without the owner prefix.

since.description: Lower-bound timestamp for issues, issue_comments, and pull_request_review_comments (incremental start; also usable as a fresh-sync start_config_key value).

token.description: GitHub token: classic PAT, fine-grained PAT, OAuth token, GitHub Actions GITHUB_TOKEN, or a pre-generated installation access token. Used only for Bearer auth; never logged.
